As a Forklift and/or Reach Truck Operator, you are responsible for keeping the warehouse and shipping process running efficiently. Your daily tasks include collecting and moving goods, scanning shipments, checking orders for accuracy, loading and unloading trucks, and maintaining a clean and safe working environment. You are also happy to support other departments whenever needed, because teamwork is at the heart of DSV. 
You will work full-time (40 hours per week) in a fixed team at the Moerdijk warehouse and are willing to work in a two-shift schedule. 
 Waar ga je werken? 
DSV Contract Logistics B.V. is a global leader in transport and logistics. In Moerdijk, you will work in a modern warehouse equipped with the latest technology. The location is easily accessible by car with free parking or by public transport from Dordrecht. 
You will become part of a friendly and motivated team where collaboration is key. The working environment is informal, open, and supportive, and your contribution truly makes a difference. In addition, you will receive attractive shift allowances ranging from 20% up to 100% for evening, night, weekend, and public holiday shifts.
